notes.title: GRANDIA & Dokuro End of Summer Sale 2022!
notes.content:
Event Period: 8/11/2022 10:00 AM PDT - 8/18/2022 10:00 AM PDT
Heat wave got you stuck indoors? Never fear, we’ve got exciting worlds of our own for you to explore… head out on a summer adventure with this season’s sale on GRANDIA HD Remaster, GRANDIA II HD Remaster, and Dokuro!
[b]
GRANDIA HD Remaster[/b] and [b]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/b] bring enhanced visuals and other quality of life improvements to one of the most critically acclaimed JRPG universes of all time. In GRANDIA HD Remaster, journey with Justin to protect the powerful secrets of an ancient civilization from the forces of evil! Or take up the sword of a mercenary in GRANDIA II, where Ryudo and his band of companions are swept up in a fight much larger and older than they are. 
Both games are now[b] 50% off[/b] and available for just [b]$9.99[/b] until 8/18!

Classic JRPG heroes aren’t all we have, though; [b]Dokuro[/b] takes an entirely different and (unlikely) protagonist center stage in one sweet skeleton’s quest to save the Princess. This puzzle-platformer brings a dark fairytale to life with unique chalk-style artwork, as well as a surprising amount of heart and wit–for a story about a bone-head.

Dokuro can be purchased for [b]$0.99[/b] until the end of the sale period–that’s [b]90% off![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/330390/GRANDIA_II_HD_Remaster/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/317840/Dokuro/

Thank you for spending your summer with us here at GungHo, and we hope you enjoy the lovingly crafted stories on sale. Be sure to follow us for all updates and news on Twitter

notes.title: Summer Sale Season Is Here with Some Scorching Savings!
notes.content:
The start of summer always marks the beginning of beach days, barbecues, and sunburns! Ouch. Luckily, you can play inside without turning into a lobster with these two incredible sales! On Steam, all your favorite games are on deep discounts through Steam’s Summer Sale [b]from 6/24 to 7/8[/b]!

If there is anyone who could benefit from a bit of a tan, it would be [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/317840/Dokuro/]Dokuro[/url][/i]! This short ‘n’ sweet skeleton will do anything to save his Princess from her perilous plight in this peculiar puzzle platformer. Can this pair escape the Dark Lord’s sand castle with your help? Find out today [b]for $0.99--a scorching 90% savings[/b]!

If you would like to spend your summer days exploring new worlds and protecting forgotten civilizations, then why not pick up a sizzling selection of sagas? In the worlds of [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/]GRANDIA HD Remaster[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/330390/GRANDIA_II_HD_Remaster/]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/url][/i], you can join Justin, Ryudo, and their loyal companions as they embark on journeys to save the world from nefarious ne’er-do-wells. Experience these classic chronicles [b]for 50% off[/b] with [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/]GRANDIA HD Remaster[/url][/i] [b]for $9.99[/b] and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/330390/GRANDIA_II_HD_Remaster/]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/url][/i] [b]for $9.99[/b] for a limited time only!

Hey, Senpai! I just love summertime, man! You can join me in the Tower of Barbs with these dope [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794600/LET_IT_DIE/]LET IT DIE[/url][/i] bundles to help your climb! [b]For only $14.99[/b], the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/907881/LET_IT_DIE_Platinum_Pack/]Platinum Pack[/url] contains 50 Death Metals to get back up after being knocked down. The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/907880/LET_IT_DIE_Special_Pack/]Special Pack[/url] is on sale [b]for $24.99[/b], which includes 30 Death Metals, a 30-day Express Pass, daily login bonuses, and more! These [b]50% off[/b] steals will totally NOT last so act fast, Senpai!

The world of [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282930/VoltaX/]Volta-X[/url][/i] will never be the same with its latest update, the Metaverse! Customize your own battle mech as you fight to save the world against otherworldly threats. Once you have achieved your glory in the story mode, compete against your own legend in the all-new rogue mode! Heed the call today [b]for only $9.99 (50% off)[/b]. Welcome to the Metaverse, pilots!

We are GungHo about our games and we hope you enjoy some of our favorite titles for these red hot prices. Please also be sure to follow us for more game event updates on Twitter [b][url=https://twitter.com/GungHo_America]@GungHo_America[/url][/b]!

notes.title: Luck is Coming Your Way in this Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.content:

Generally, generosity and kindness begets prosperity. Find out if the kind-hearted skeleton Dokuro’s generosity in helping the Princess escape the Dark Lord’s castle leads to prosperity for the daring duo by helping them solve puzzles! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/317840/Dokuro/][i][b]Dokuro [/b][/i][/url]will be on sale for a staggering $0.99 (90% off!!!).

2021 is the year of the metal ox. While [b][i]Volta-X[/i][/b] doesn’t feature any oxen, you’ll be able to play with a crew of other animals, some part of the Zodiac, to help you pilot a gigantic (metal) Volta! Pick up [i][b]Volta-X[/b][/i] on sale for $9.99 (50% off) and paint your Volta red for luck in your next battle.

It’s tradition to give and receive red envelopes to celebrate the new Lunar New Year. Although maybe it’s time to make a new tradition, but still give the gift of something classic, like the [i][b]GRANDIA [/b][/i]series! You can get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/][i][b]GRANDIA HD Remaster[/b][/i][/url], which is on sale for $9.99 (50% off) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/330390/GRANDIA_II_HD_Remaster/][i][b]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/b][/i][/url] at $9.99 (50% off) during this time.  

Like, you’re pretty darn lucky, because two [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794600/LET_IT_DIE/][i][b]LET IT DIE[/b][/i][/url] bundles are available! The first bundle, which is $14.99 (50% off), contains 50 Death Metals, which you can spend to help you get you back on your feet if you want to continue taking on the Tower of Barbs after dying! The second bundle, which is $24.99 (50% off), contains 30 Death Metals and a 30-day Express Pass, which offers things like access to the Royal Elevator, a once-a-day “limited decal” login bonus, and more.

May the new year bring you happiness and prosperity. Thank you for being as GungHo about our games as we are and hope you get to enjoy some of our favorite games at their limited sale prices while you can!

notes.title: Dive Into Dokuro While It's on Sale... If You Dare!
notes.content:
It’s that time of year again, filled with pumpkin spiced lattes, cool crisp air, and some howling good deals for the Halloween Sale on Steam. Stay inside and celebrate Halloween safely this year by picking up some candy for yourself as well as the following GungHo titles at a discounted price from 10/29-11/2 PT! 

Rattle your bones with [i][b]Dokuro[/b][/i], which is $2.50 (75% off) this GungHo-lloween! This isn’t your typical “save the princess” story. Follow Dokuro, a skeletal worker for the Dark Lord, as he helps the princess, whose tears broke his heart, escape from the Dark Lord’s castle after being kidnapped. Put on your thinkin' cap as you traverse through levels that seemingly get trickier and trickier as you progress. 

Sad you can’t don that really cool robot costume you got earlier this year with the intention of being the biggest hit at a Halloween party? Never fear for [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282930/VoltaX/]Volta-X[/url] [/b][/i]is here at the price of $9.99 (50% off)! Get in your robot costume and then do the exact same thing, but on the digital ‘scape, with hundreds of other robot enthusiasts in [i][b]Volta-X[/b][/i]. Get into intense robot battles where you control your Volta with the assistance of the cutest crew! Upgrade and build your Volta to match your battle style, three chainsaws seems like a bit much, but you do you, boo. 

Keep it classic and nab[i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034860/GRANDIA_HD_Remaster/] GRANDIA HD Remaster[/url][/b][/i] for $13.99 (30% off) or [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/330390/GRANDIA_II_HD_Remaster/]GRANDIA II HD Remaster[/url][/b][/i] also on sale for $9.99 (50% off)! If you’re not familiar with either game, see why the [i][b]GRANDIA [/b][/i]series is considered legendary and lives up to its reputation with timeless stories, real time battle systems, and much more! Follow the exciting adventures of Justin, Sue, and Feena to see what lies beyond the End of the World in [i][b]GRANDIA [/b][/i]or explore the captivating story of [i][b]GRANDIA II[/b][/i] with Ryudo and Elena in their life-changing mission.

Like, ZOMG, [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/794600/LET_IT_DIE/]LET IT DIE[/url][/b][/i] has two special packs you can pick up at 50% off each! Download [i][b]LET IT DIE[/b][/i] for free and make your way up the Tower of Barbs with intense battles of grit and gore. Collect/concoct unique weapons and stylish ways to finish off foes… you know, to survive and all. Uncle Death’s got your back, senpai! Can you make it to the top of the Tower of Barbs if you start in your underwear, though? With the help of these one-time only DLC packs -- the Special Pack at $14.99 and the Platinum Pack at $24.99 -- you can improve your strategy to reach the top with additional Death Metals, Kill Coins, and much more, you just might be able to take on all the challenges the Tower of Barbs throws at you.

Whatever it is that you decide to do this Halloween, we hope it is fun and safe!

notes.title: Partial Controller Support Added!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpa1/v/t1.0-9/10649625_813475635396151_3786279606634378198_n.png?oh=74d71025cb9a141e3e5f7984c274f231&oe=5577F6E2[/IMG]

March 23, 2015. We greatly appreciated all of your feedback, so we’re proud to announce that the latest update has added partial controller support for Dokuro. Once you’re in-game, a controller can be used to control all of Dokuro’s basic actions. You’ll still need a mouse to activate the almighty chalk, but the controller support will definitely help in those action-packed platforming segments!

To celebrate the update, Dokuro will be 40% off from 3/23 to 3/29! If you still haven’t picked up this charming chalk fairy tale, now is the perfect time!
